violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CUT CABBAGE IN COLD WELL AT 48-52F, CUT PURPLE CABBAGE ON ICE AT 55-57F, AND FRIED BASIL AT 62F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC ADDED MORE COLD WATER AND ICE TO COLD WELL/ICE BATH. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE FOOD ITEMS SHOULD STAY AT 41F OR BELOW AT ALL TIMES. FRIED BASIL WILL BE KEPT ON TIME FROM NOW ON. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION TO AVOID FURTHER ENFORCEMENT ACTION.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD THERMOMETER BATTERY DEAD AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PLEASE ENSURE THE FOOD THERMOMETER IS OPERATIONAL BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED A DEAD COCKROACH AND ONE ALIVE COCKROACH ON THE HANDWASHING SINK CLOSEST TO THE DISHWASHING MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC PROVIDED EHS WITH MOST RECENT PEST CONTROL INVOICE (5/11/26). PLEASE ENSURE PEST CONTROL TREAT THE ESTABLISHMENT AND THE INVOICE IS PROVIDED TO THE EHS BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD ITEMS STORED DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC UNDERSTANDS FOOD ITEMS SHOULD NOT BE STORED ON THE FLOOR TO PREVENT CROSS CONTAMINATION AND ALLOW FOR EASY CLEANING. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. CHAO PHRA YA RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 05/15/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED WATER SPRAYING THE FLOOR FROM PIPING FOR THE HANDWASHING SINK CLOSEST TO THE DISHWASHING MACHINE PRIOR TO ENTERING THE FLOOR DRAIN. OBSERVED ODOR COMIGN FROM THE GREASE TRAP.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE INSTALL A FUNNEL TO ENSURE WATER ENTERS THE FLOOR DRAIN PROPERLY. PIC PROVIDED EHS WITH MOST RECENT GREASE TRAP INVOICE (4/21/26). PLEASE ENSURE THE GREASE TRAP IS CLEANED AGAIN SOON.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE BACK KITCHEN WALLS/FLOORS IN NEED OF CLEANING, ESPECIALLY AROUND THE COOK-LINE, CHEST FREEZERS, AND DISHWASHING/THREE-VAT SINK AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE ENSURE THE FACILITY IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED FLOOR GROUTING THROUGHOUT BACK KITCHEN IN CERTAIN AREAS IN NEED OF REPAIR.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC INFORMED THE EHS THAT THE FACILITY PLANS ON RENOVATING THE MAJORITY OF THE ESTABLISHMENT IN SEPTEMBER. PLEASE ENSURE FLOOR IS REPAIRED AND DOCUMENTATION IS PROVIDED TO THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT AND OTHER AGENCIES PRIOR TO STARTING ANY MAJOR RENOVATIONS.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: OBSERVED CHICKEN PARTIALLY COOKED IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. PIC UNDERSTANDS NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS IS NOT PERMITTED UNLESS WRITTEN PLANS ARE SUBMITTED AND APPROVED AND THE FACILITY HAS TEMPERATURE LOGS. PIC AGREED TO DISCONTINUE PROCESS. CHAO PHRA YA RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 11/24/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED LEMONGRASS AND CARROT/CABBAGE SOUP BASE ON COUNTERTOP AT 68-71F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED OF SOUP BASE DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS WHEN PLANTS ARE COOKED/HEATED THEY ARE RENDERED TCS. PLEASE ENSURE HOT FOODS ARE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE AT ALL TIMES.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CUT CABBAGE AT 45-55F, FRIED TOFU AT 50F, AND RAW SHELLED EGGS IN COLD WELL. OBSERVED PORK DUMPLING AT 46F, PORK WONTON AT 46F, AND COOKED DUCK AT 45F IN RIGHT TWO-DOOR PREP TOP. OBSERVED PANANG CURRY SAUCE AT 50F IN WALK-IN COOLER. OBSERVED FACILITY FRYING GARLIC AND KEEPING IT AT AMBIENT TEMPERATURE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED FOODS TO ANOTHER COOLER DURING INSPECTION. EHS DISCUSSED TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOODS WITH THE PIC. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW AT ALL TIMES, OR TIME CONTROL SHOULD BE USED. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION AND STAFF. ARE TRAINED ON PROPER PRACTICES.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED VARIOUS CONTAINERS OF SPICES AT THE COOK-LINE AND OTHER WORKING CONTAINERS OF FOOD ITEMS WITHOUT A LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL FOODS NOT IN ORIGINAL CONTAINER SHOULD BE LABELED.
